tasks.subject: Task 1: Update config layer
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Remove `Release bool` and rename `Format → VersionFormat` in `BranchConfig`; update `DefaultConfig()` to add `master` pattern and use new field; update `validate.go`; rewrite affected tests.

**Files:**
- Modify: `config/config.go`
- Modify: `config/validate.go`
- Modify: `config/config_test.go`
- Modify: `config/validate_test.go`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `BranchConfig` has no `Release` field, uses `VersionFormat string \`yaml:"version_format"\``
- [ ] `DefaultConfig()` returns 3 branches: `main`, `master` (no `version_format`), `.*` with template
- [ ] `validate.go` validates `version_format` template syntax (not `format`)
- [ ] All config tests pass

**Verify:** `go test ./config/... -v` → all tests PASS

```json:metadata
{"files": ["config/config.go", "config/validate.go", "config/config_test.go", "config/validate_test.go"], "verifyCommand": "go test ./config/... -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["BranchConfig has no Release field, uses VersionFormat string", "DefaultConfig returns 3 branches: main, master, .*", "validate.go validates version_format template syntax", "All config tests pass"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Update strategy layer
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Update `semver.go` to use `VersionFormat` instead of `Release`/`Format`; update `matchBranch()` fallback; update all test fixtures; add new tests.

**Files:**
- Modify: `strategy/semver/semver.go`
- Modify: `strategy/semver/semver_test.go`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `Current()` uses `versionFormat == ""` check (not `branchCfg.Release`)
- [ ] `Current()` always prepends `tagPrefix` to rendered output
- [ ] `varsCore()` sets `IsPreRelease = branchCfg.VersionFormat != ""`
- [ ] `matchBranch()` fallback uses `VersionFormat` field
- [ ] `TestVars_isPreRelease` and `TestCurrent_tagPrefixPrependedOnPreRelease` pass
- [ ] All strategy tests pass

**Verify:** `go test ./strategy/semver/... -v` → all tests PASS

```json:metadata
{"files": ["strategy/semver/semver.go", "strategy/semver/semver_test.go"], "verifyCommand": "go test ./strategy/semver/... -v", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Current() uses versionFormat == \"\" check", "Current() always prepends tagPrefix", "varsCore() sets IsPreRelease = branchCfg.VersionFormat != \"\"", "matchBranch() fallback uses VersionFormat", "New tests TestVars_isPreRelease and TestCurrent_tagPrefixPrependedOnPreRelease pass", "All strategy tests pass"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Update documentation
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Update all doc examples that reference the old `release:`/`format:` YAML fields to use `version_format:` instead.

**Files:**
- Modify: `docs/reference.md`
- Modify: `docs/how-to.md`
- Modify: `docs/tutorial.md`
- Modify: `docs/explanation.md`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `docs/reference.md` config schema shows `version_format` (no `release`, no `format`)
- [ ] `docs/how-to.md` all branch config examples use `version_format`
- [ ] `docs/tutorial.md` step 4 config uses `version_format`
- [ ] `docs/explanation.md` "Releases vs pre-releases" section updated to reflect new semantics

**Verify:** Manual review — no occurrence of `release: true`, `release: false`, or `format:` in docs YAML examples

```json:metadata
{"files": ["docs/reference.md", "docs/how-to.md", "docs/tutorial.md", "docs/explanation.md"], "verifyCommand": "grep -rn 'release: true\\|release: false\\|format:' docs/ || echo 'Clean'", "acceptanceCriteria": ["reference.md config schema shows version_format", "how-to.md all branch config examples use version_format", "tutorial.md step 4 config uses version_format", "explanation.md Releases vs pre-releases section updated"]}
```
